title: Calculated columns and sorting (margin)
theory:
Ab tak tumne table ke columns seedhe select kiye. Par SQL **naye columns bana bhi sakta hai**, jo table me store nahi hote, sirf result me dikhte hain. Isse **calculated column** kehte hain.

Example: `products` table me `price` (bechne ka rate) aur `cost` (kharid rate) hai. **Margin** = `price - cost`. Margin table me nahi hai, hum query me nikalte hain.

**Aliasing:** `AS margin` result column ko naam deta hai. Naam khud choose karo, par spelling dhyan se likho: `margin` aur `margine` do alag naam hain.

**Query kis order me chalti hai (SQLite andar se):**
- `FROM products`: pehle table uthao
- `SELECT name, price - cost AS margin`: har row ke liye calculation karo
- `ORDER BY margin DESC`: bade se chhota sort karo (`DESC` = descending, `ASC` = chhote se bada)
- `LIMIT 5`: sirf upar ki 5 rows rakho

Yaad rakho: `ORDER BY` me alias use kar sakte ho, par `WHERE` me nahi.

examples.title: Annual salary jaisa calculation: price ka 10% discount
examples.why: **Run karne se pehle:** SQL har product ki row padhega, `price * 0.9` nikalega aur use `discounted` naam dega. Sirf pehli 5 rows dikhengi. Table me kuch change nahi hota.
examples.sql: SELECT name, price, price * 0.9 AS discounted FROM products LIMIT 5;

examples.title: Sabse mehenge 3 products
examples.why: **Run karne se pehle:** pehle saari rows `price` ke hisaab se bade se chhote sort hongi, fir upar ke 3 bachenge. Agar `DESC` hata do to sabse sasta pehle aayega.
examples.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;

exercises.task: Sabse zyada margin wale 5 products dikhao: columns name aur margin (price - cost), margin bade se chhota.
exercises.before:
**Plan:**
- `name` seedha select hoga.
- `price - cost AS margin` har product ka profit nikalega.
- `ORDER BY margin DESC` sabse zyada profit upar layega.
- `LIMIT 5` sirf top 5 rakhega.

**Result me kya aayega:** 2 columns (name, margin) aur 5 rows, margin ghatte order me.
exercises.hint1: Calculated column likho: price - cost AS margin.
exercises.hint2: Last me ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5 lagao.
exercises.solution: SELECT name, price - cost AS margin FROM products ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5;
explain: price - cost AS margin: har row ka profit nikala aur naam diya
ORDER BY margin DESC: sabse bada margin pehle

exercises.task: 5 sabse sasta products dikhao: name aur price, price chhote se bada.
exercises.before: **Plan:** is baar sort `ASC` (chhote se bada) hoga. Default order bhi ASC hota hai, par likhna saaf padhne me madad karta hai.
exercises.hint1: ORDER BY price ASC use karo.
exercises.solution: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5;
explain: ORDER BY price ASC: sabse sasta pehle

exercises.task: Margin percentage nikalo: name aur margin_pct = (price - cost) * 100.0 / price, 1 decimal tak ROUND karke. Sabse zyada margin_pct wale 5 products dikhao.
exercises.before:
**Plan:**
- `(price - cost) * 100.0 / price` profit ko price ka percent banata hai. `100.0` (decimal) isliye likhte hain taaki integer division na ho.
- `ROUND(x, 1)` result ko 1 decimal par kaat deta hai.
- Fir sort DESC aur LIMIT 5.
exercises.hint2: ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 5 lagao.
exercises.solution: SELECT name, ROUND((price - cost) * 100.0 / price, 1) AS margin_pct FROM products ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
